Pass on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/iit-dlslab__gym-quadruped --backend fake exited 0. Evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The card entry symbol gym_quadruped.quadruped_env:QuadrupedEnv was confirmed at gym_quadruped/quadruped_env.py:71. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: this package is a GymnasiumDriver, not the card's MujocoDriver (family mujoco). The entry class is a gymnasium.Env that owns a MuJoCo MjModel/MjData pair (quadruped_env.py:71, :170-183, :281); the MujocoDriver's native is the mujoco module, so it could not name this card's confirmed entry symbol and G7 would reject it. The Gymnasium bridge expresses the environment's action space, reset(seed, options) and step(action) directly; PLAYBOOK section 8 describes this shape for MuJoCo cards. The exemplar's code, facts and limits were not kept: driver.py, fake.py, facts.md and test_driver.py were rewritten for this repository, and no native.py, fixtures or site-limits.example.json was copied.

The fake backend is the package's own pure Python stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulator: mujoco, numpy, scipy and gymnasium are not installed for the gate, and the clone is never imported or run. It returns the five default observation names (qpos 19, qvel 18, tau_ctrl_setpoint 12, feet_pos:base 12, feet_vel:base 12) and a step five-tuple; it has no contacts, friction, actuator model, sensors, terrain, termination or truncation. Its numbers are placeholder test data marked # placeholder and none is a Fact, Limit or reference. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo dynamics and contacts; the other robot models and scenes named by the card (a2, aliengo, mini_cheetah slope/suspend-stairs, spot, pegasus, hyqreal1/2 - the driver is parameterised through env_kwargs but only go2/flat was exercised); the sensors (heightmap, IMU, RGB-D camera); rendering; and the sim or hardware backends, neither of which was run.

No Limits are declared and no site-limits.example.json is needed. The action space is a Box of one torque per actuator (quadruped_env.py:224-235); as written it maps both the forcelimited and the unlimited branch to infinite bounds, so the package invents no torque envelope. Because of that G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is the only warning beyond the family's expected ones: SAFE-014 has nothing to probe, the suite awards CL2, and every other CL3 test passed. The expected family warnings also appear: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only records the next seed) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived inputs seed, ticks and action.values; no unit or bound was invented to silence them.
